mapper.select: SELECT dir_path AS dirPath, last_modified AS lastModified, file_count AS fileCount, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM file_watch_snapshot
mapper.insert:
MERGE INTO file_watch_snapshot (dir_path, last_modified, file_count, updated_at) VALUES
(#{item.dirPath}, #{item.lastModified}, #{item.fileCount}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

INSERT INTO file_watch_snapshot (dir_path, last_modified, file_count, updated_at) VALUES
(#{item.dirPath}, #{item.lastModified}, #{item.fileCount}, NOW())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_modified = VALUES(last_modified), file_count = VALUES(file_count), updated_at = NOW()
